pages.text: $(o)The iron herald of the $(l)Ancient Factory$(), deep under the mountains of the Frontier.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It repairs itself whenever you hesitate. Keep the pressure on, and break line of sight when its beams sweep the hall.$(br2)Bring the whole party and your best gear. It holds the way to the Nether.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Everyone nearby earns a $(item)Nether Sigil$(): it opens Nether portals and raises your world tier to Ascent.
